blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We introduce a post-training method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that minimizes Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) between generated and reference distributions in the feature space of a frozen pretrained DLM.
To estimate MMD, we retain contextual features at individual token positions, obtaining multiple observations per sequence from a single extractor pass.
We optimize this objective using policy gradients for discrete models and direct differentiation through generated latents for continuous models.
In both cases, computing the loss directly from these features enables efficient post-training without full sampling trajectories or jointly trained auxiliary models.
Experiments show lower generative perplexity at comparable entropy on OpenWebText and better accuracy–computation trade-offs on GSM8K.
On 16B DMax-LLaDA2.0 models with hybrid masked–uniform diffusion, we increase decoding parallelism with similar or higher accuracy on math and code benchmarks.
Code is available at yandex-research/dlm-mmd .
blocks.zh:
我们采用了一种用于传播语言模型(DLM)的训练后方法,在被冻结的预先训练的DLM的特性空间中,将生成和参考分布之间的最大平均值(MMD)降到最低.
为了估算MMD,我们保留了单个标语位置的上下文特征,从单个提取器的通道中获取每个序列的多个观测.
我们利用政策梯度来优化这一目标,促进离散模型,并通过产生连续模型的潜在因素来进行直接区分。
在这两种情况下,直接计算这些特征造成的损失,使得在没有完全取样轨迹或联合培训的辅助模型的情况下能够进行有效的后培训。
实验显示在OpenWebText上的可比较的entropy上基因复杂度较低,在GSM8K上的精确度-计算取舍更好.
在16B DMax-LLaDA2.0模型上,带有混合遮罩-单体扩散,我们增加解码平行主义,数学和代码基准的精确度相近或更高.
代码在yandex-Research/dlm-mmd 中可用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text by refining noisy inputs in a discrete token space or a continuous latent space.
In discrete models, token-wise cross-entropy trains a factorized denoiser to fit conditional token marginals.
In continuous models, squared-error prediction of clean latents estimates their conditional mean.
These conditional estimates guide iterative sampling, but do not necessarily yield high-quality samples in a few steps.
blocks.zh:
分化语言模型(DLMs)通过在离散的符号空间或连续的潜入空间中精炼出噪音输入来生成文本.
在离散型号中,指使-通向相交的列车会是一个被分解的去向式(denoiser)来适应有条件的指使边.
在连续的模型中,对清洁潜伏物的平方-偏差预测估计其条件平均值.
这些有条件的估计指导了迭代取样,但不一定在几个步骤中产生出高质量的样品.

blocks.en:
Diffusion distillation addresses this challenge in several ways.
Some methods train a student to reproduce several teacher denoising updates in fewer steps ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Luhman and Luhman, 2021 ; Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025b ) .
Others obtain distribution-matching gradients using an auxiliary model trained on the generator’s evolving outputs ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Hoogeboom et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
These methods improve sampling efficiency but require teacher-derived targets or jointly trained auxiliary models.
Therefore, we ask whether a useful distributional training signal can instead be computed directly from generated and reference samples.
blocks.zh:
分泌蒸馏从若干方面解决了这一挑战。
一些方法训练学生在更少的步子上再现几个老师去命名更新(Salimans and Ho, 2022;Luhman and Luhman, 2021;Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2025;Kim等, 2025b.).
其他人则利用对发电机不断演变的输出结果进行培训的辅助模型获得配分梯度(Yin等,2024b;Hoogeboom等,2026;Zheng等,2026)。
这些方法提高了取样效率,但需要教师提供的目标或联合培训的辅助模型。
因此,我们询问是否可以直接从生成的和参考的样本中计算出有用的分布式训练信号。

blocks.en:
Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) offers this possibility through kernel similarities between samples ( Gretton et al., 2012 ) .
However, its effectiveness depends on the comparison space, since simple distances in high-dimensional spaces need not capture meaningful differences between outputs ( Li et al., 2017 ; Li et al., 2015 ) .
In this context, learned representations offer a promising comparison space for both discrete sequences and continuous outputs.
In visual generation, MMD and related objectives in pretrained feature spaces have enabled high-quality generation with one or a few steps ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Starodubcev et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) .
More recently, feature matching has improved LLM fine-tuning by comparing statistics of generated and reference sequences ( Jelassi et al., 2026 ) .
Together, these results suggest that a fixed pretrained feature space can provide an effective training signal for distribution matching.
blocks.zh:
最大平均值差异(MMD)通过样品之间的内核相似性提供了这种可能性(Gretton等,2012年)。
然而,其有效性取决于比较空间,因为高维空间的简单距离不需要捕捉产出之间的有意义的差异(Li等,2017;Li等,2015.).
在这方面,学到的表述为离散序列和连续产出提供了有希望的比较空间。
在视觉生成中,MMD和被预训的地物空间中的相关目标通过一或几个步骤(杨等,2026;Starodubcev等,2026;邓等,2026.
最近,特征匹配通过比较生成序列和参考序列的统计数据改进了LLM的微调(Jelassi等人,2026年)。
这些结果加在一起表明,一个固定的预先训练的地物空间可以为分配匹配提供有效的训练信号.

blocks.en:
In this work, we explore MMD for post-training both discrete and continuous DLMs.
We use a frozen pretrained DLM to extract contextual features at individual positions, obtaining multiple observations from each generated or reference sequence in a single extractor pass.
We then train the generator to match the distributions of these features.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们探索MMD用于离散和连续的DLM两种后期训练.
我们使用被冷冻的预先训练的DLM来提取单个位置的上下文特征,从每个生成的或参考序列中以一个取出子的通道获得多个观测结果.
然后我们训练发电机 以匹配这些特性的分布。

blocks.en:
For discrete models, we sample sequences from the token distributions produced by a single denoiser pass and optimize the resulting MMD reward using REINFORCE with a leave-one-out baseline.
We instantiate it as MDLM-MMD for masked-token prediction ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ) and as DMax-MMD for hybrid masked–uniform diffusion ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , where MMD trains both masked prediction and refinement of the model’s own token predictions.
blocks.zh:
对于离散模型,我们从一个单一的Denoiser通过生成的符号分配中抽取序列,并使用一个一出基线的REINFORCE来优化由此产生的MMD奖励.
我们用MDLM-MMD作为遮掩的预测(Sahoo等,2024年)和MDax-MMD作为混合遮掩-单体扩散(Chen等,2026年b),MMD在此同时进行遮掩的预测和完善模型本身的象征性预测。

blocks.en:
For continuous DLMs (CDLMs), we initialize a generator from a pretrained Embedded Language Flows (ELF) model ( Hu et al., 2026 ) and train it to map Gaussian noise to clean latent sequences in a single step.
In this case, MMD gradients directly propagate through the frozen ELF feature extractor and the generated latents.
At inference, we use self-conditioning to iteratively refine the single-step predictions, extending the generator to multi-step sampling.
blocks.zh:
对于连续DLMs(CDLMs),我们从预先训练的嵌入式语言流(ELF)模型(Hu等,2026年)中初始化出一个生成器,并训练它绘制高斯噪声图以在单步中清除潜伏序列.
在这种情况下,MMD梯度直接通过冷冻的ELF特征提取器和所生成的潜伏物来传播.
推论,我们使用自修来迭代地完善单步预测,将发电机扩展到多步取样.

blocks.en:
We evaluate both realizations on OpenWebText and TinyGSM, where they outperform the evaluated distribution-matching and flow-map baselines in most setups.
At the 16B scale, we show that DMax-MMD improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on established math and code benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们评价OpenWebText和TinyGSM上的实现,它们比大多数设置中评估的分布匹配和流图基线要好.
在16B尺度上,我们显示DMax-MMD改进了既定数学和代码基准的精确效率权衡.

In masked diffusion, the noise distribution is concentrated on an absorbing [MASK] symbol, and the denoiser preserves visible tokens ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) .
Pretraining minimizes weighted cross-entropy over masked positions.
At inference, generation starts from a fully masked sequence and progressively reveals tokens ( Nie et al., 2025 ) .
We use confidence-threshold decoding ( Wu et al., 2026 ) ,
which adaptively determines how many tokens are revealed per step.

Sampling typically starts from a uniformly random sequence and repeatedly updates all positions, allowing earlier predictions to be revised ( Austin et al., 2021a ) .

blocks.zh: 3.1 代表空间MMD 培训

blocks.en:
To compare generated and reference samples with MMD, we need a representation in which to measure their similarity.
A pretrained DLM already computes features that describe tokens in their available context, making it a natural choice of feature extractor.
Therefore, we use a frozen pretrained DLM and collect its intermediate hidden states, ϕ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) = ( ϕ 1 ​ ( 𝐱 ) , … , ϕ L ​ ( 𝐱 ) ) ∈ ℝ L × D , \phi(\mathbf{x})=\bigl(\phi_{1}(\mathbf{x}),\ldots,\phi_{L}(\mathbf{x})\bigr)\in\mathbb{R}^{L\times D}, (2) where L L is the sequence length and D D is the feature dimension.

预先训练的 DLM 已经计算出在它们可用的上下文中描述符号的特性,使其成为特性提取器的自然选择.

In practice, we extract features from clean samples, as corruption at intermediate diffusion timesteps did not improve performance in our experiments.
We apply the same extraction rule to real and generated samples and explore alternative extractors in App. C.2 .

blocks.en:
Pooling the features into a single embedding would leave only one observation per sequence.
Instead, we retain the individual representations, obtaining | S | |S| feature samples in one forward pass, where S S is the nonempty set of scored positions.
This provides more observations for MMD estimation, which is especially useful when only a single reference is available for a condition.

相反,我们保留了个人的表述,在一条前传中获取了 S Q S Q S 的特征样本,其中 S 是非空的一组得分位置.
这为MMD估计提供了更多的观测结果,当只为一个条件提供单一的参考时,这种估计特别有用.

blocks.en:
We score all positions for unconditional latent generation, response positions for prompted latent generation, and masked positions for masked DLMs.
The extractor still processes the available context, so the selected features can carry information from outside S S .
Features within a sequence can therefore be dependent, which we account for in the estimator below.

In MDLM-MMD , 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} is formed by masking tokens and S S contains only masked positions, so visible tokens remain unchanged.

blocks.en:
Later refinement steps receive the model’s previous predictions as self-conditioning, which differ from the null input used for one-step generation.
To expose the model to these inputs during training, we uniformly sample the number of preliminary refinement steps from { 0 , … , n − 1 } \{0,\ldots,n-1\} , where n n is the maximum number of generator passes including the final differentiable step.
We run these preliminary steps with fixed noise and without gradients, then apply MMD to one additional prediction and backpropagate only through this final step.
blocks.zh:
后来的完善步骤收到模型之前作为自修的预测,这与单步生成所使用的无效输入不同.
为了让模型在训练中接触到这些投入,我们从{0,.,n- 1}}的{0,\ldots,n-1}中统一抽取出初步改进步骤的数目,其中n是发电机通过的最大数量,包括最后的可分步骤.
我们用固定的噪音和没有梯度来运行这些初步步骤,然后将MMD应用到一个额外的预测中,并且只能通过这一最后步骤进行后卫.

blocks.en:
In addition, to reduce the number of evaluations needed at inference, we optionally apply iterative refinement distillation (IRD) after MMD training.
A frozen ELF-MMD teacher supplies the final prediction of a multi-step trajectory, which a student learns to reproduce in one step ( Yoo et al., 2026 ; Luhman and Luhman, 2021 ) .
We describe the distillation objective in App. B.1 .
blocks.zh:
此外,为了减少推断所需的评价数量,我们在MMD培训后可选择采用迭代精细分馏法(IRD).
一名被冻结的ELF-MMD教师提供了多步轨道的最终预测,一个学生学习一步再生(Yoo等,2026;Luhman和Luhman,2021).
我们在App.B.1中描述了蒸馏目标。

blocks.en:
We note that the MMD loss is also applicable to the continuous DLM variants that do not use self-conditioning ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2026 ) .
Instead of iterative refinement, they could be adapted to use alternative multi-step sampling schemes, such as consistency sampling ( Song et al., 2023 ) , that are widely explored for visual generators ( Sauer et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2024a ) .
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,MMD损失也适用于不使用自毁的连续DLM变体(Lee等,2026;Deschenaux和Gulcehre,2026)。
与其进行反复改进,不如加以调整,以采用替代的多步骤取样办法,例如一致性取样(Song等,2023年),这些办法被广泛用于视觉发电机(Sauer等,2024年;Yin等,2024年a).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
In this section, we evaluate whether representation-space MMD improves generation at limited sampling budgets for both discrete and continuous DLMs.
We first study unconditional generation on OpenWebText and mathematical reasoning on GSM8K, then test the approach on 16B DMax models.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们评价代表性-空间磁共振磁共振是否在分散和连续的DLM的有限采样预算中改进生成。
我们首先在OpenWebText和GSM8K上的数学推理上研究无条件的生成,然后在16B DMAx模型上测试方法.

blocks.en: 4.1 Unconditional Generation
blocks.zh: 4.1 无条件生成

blocks.en:
For unconditional generation, we follow prior work ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) and train on OpenWebText (OWT) ( Gokaslan and Cohen, 2019 ) with sequences packed to length L = 1024 L=1024 .
We evaluate 1,000 1{,}000 generated samples using generative perplexity (Gen. PPL) under pretrained GPT-2 Large ( Radford et al., 2019 ) and average unigram entropy.
We use the data entropy ( H ≈ 5.43 H\approx 5.43 ) as a reference, rather than treating higher entropy as uniformly better.
blocks.zh:
对于无条件的一代,我们遵循先前的工作(Hu等,2026;Lee等,2026;Chen等,2026a),并使用OpenWebText(OWT)(Gokaslan和Cohen,2019)进行列车,其编组顺序为L=1024 L=1024.
我们利用基因过敏性(Gen.PPL)在预训GPT-2大型(Radford等,2019年)和平均单子 en下,对1000 1{,}000个生成的样本进行评估.
我们使用数据 en(H ≈ 5.43 H\相 5.43 )作为参考,而不是将更高的 en作为统一更好的处理.

blocks.en:
We initialize MDLM-MMD from a pretrained MDLM ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ) and compute MMD rewards using features from a frozen MDLM feature extractor, with policy-gradient group size G = 4 G=4 .
We compare against DiDi-Instruct ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , IDLM ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and IDLM-REINFORCE, which optimizes the IDLM log-ratio reward using policy gradients. This comparison helps distinguish the effects of the training objective and the optimization procedure.
We evaluate each method at 8 8 , 16 16 , and 32 32 sampling steps, varying the sampling temperature to characterize the trade-off between generative perplexity and sample entropy.
As shown in Fig. 2 , MDLM-MMD achieves lower generative perplexity than all baselines at matched entropy.
In particular, interpolating the curves at the reference-data entropy gives ∼ 17 {\sim}17 – 21 % 21\% lower generative perplexity than IDLM across the three sampling budgets. Exact numbers are reported in Tab. 2 .
blocks.zh:
我们从预先训练的MDLM(Sahoo等,2024年)中初始化MDLM-MMD,并使用冷冻的MDLM特性提取器的特性来计算MMD的奖励,其政策级组大小为G=4G=4.
我们比较了DiDi-Instruct(郑等,2026年),IDLM(李等,2026年)和IDLM-REINFORCE,它们利用政策梯度优化了IDLM的对等奖励. 这种比较有助于区分培训目标和优化程序的效果。
我们以8 8 、16 16 和 32 32 个采样步骤评估每种方法, 改变采样温度, 以说明基因过杂性与样本 en之间的取舍。
如图2所显示的,MDLM-MMD在相匹配的 en上实现比所有基线更低的基因杂质.
特别是,在参考数据演算上对曲线进行内插,在三个抽样预算中,使 ~ 17 {\ sim} 17 — 21 % 21 — 的基因偏差比 IDLM 低。 确切数字在Tab中报告。 2 (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en:
We use the ELF-B architecture with two choices of continuous latent space: the final-layer hidden representations of a T5-small encoder and a GPT-2 Large model, following ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Yoo et al., 2026 ) .
For both OWT and GSM8K, we report ELF-MMD, obtained by MMD post-training alone, and ELF-MMD + + IRD (App. B.1 ).
Fig. 2 compares both variants with ELF and its self-conditioning distilled variant ELF ⋆ ( Yoo et al., 2026 ) .
We also include progressively distilled ELF (ELF-PD) ( Hu et al., 2026 ) and FMLM ⋆ ( Yoo et al., 2026 ) as few-step baselines.
blocks.zh:
我们使用ELF-B架构,选择两个连续潜入空间:一个T5-小编码器的最终层隐含表示和GPT-2大模型,如下(Hu等,2026;Yoo等,2026).
对于OTW和GSM8K,我们报告仅由MMD培训后获得的ELF-MMD和ELF-MMD + + IRD(App. B.1.

blocks.en: ELF-MMD improves generation across most sampling budgets for both T5 and GPT-2 encoders. At 8 steps, it achieves lower generative perplexity and entropy closer to the reference value than ELF-PD; at 32 steps, it outperforms ELF on both metrics. IRD further improves few-step results: at 4 steps, it reduces generative perplexity relative to ELF-MMD by ∼ 30 {\sim}30 and ∼ 10 {\sim}10 points with the T5 and GPT-2 encoders, respectively, while bringing entropy closer to the reference value for both encoders. Exact numbers, together with additional results for MMD post-training of ELF ⋆ , are reported in Tab. 3 .

blocks.en: 4.2 Conditional Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2 有条件的生成

blocks.en:
For conditional generation, following ( Kim et al., 2025a ; Agarwal et al., 2026 ) , we train on TinyGSM ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and evaluate final-answer accuracy on the GSM8K test set ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) .
We pack sequences to a maximum length of L = 512 L=512 .
In addition, we report pass@ k k for both discrete and continuous DLMs using different numbers of samples per prompt (Fig. 11 ).
blocks.zh:
对于有条件的一代,依次(Kim等,2025a;Agarwal等,2026),我们用TinyGSM(Liu等,2023)进行训练,并评价GSM8K测试集的最终答案准确性(Cobbe等,2021).
我们把序列打包到最大长度为L = 512 L = 512.
此外,我们报告离散和连续的DLM通过@kk,每分时使用不同的样本(图11)。

blocks.en:
We initialize MDLM-MMD from an MDLM pretrained on TinyGSM and use frozen MDLM features for the MMD objective.
We compare against MDLM, IDLM ( Li et al., 2026 ) , IDLM-REINFORCE, and DiDi-Instruct ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
Because confidence decoding determines the number of model evaluations adaptively, we sweep the confidence threshold and report the resulting average number of steps per sequence.
As shown in Fig. 3 , MDLM-MMD achieves higher accuracy at moderate and high decoding budgets, reaching ∼ 54 % {\sim}54\% accuracy at ∼ 49 {\sim}49 steps.
blocks.zh:
我们从一个预先在TinyGSM上训练的MDLM初始化MDLM-MMD,并为MMD目标使用被冻结的MDLM特性.
我们比较了MDLM、IDLM(Li等,2026年),IDLM-REINFORCE和Di-Instruct(郑等,2026年).
由于信心解码会因地制宜地决定模型评价的数量,所以我们扫清信心阈值,并报告由此得出的每个序列的平均步数.
如图3所显示,MDLM-MMD在中高分解预算上实现了更高的精度,在QQ49 → sim}49步上达到 54% → sim}54 → 精度.

blocks.en:
Our main comparison uses ELF-B with the final-layer hidden
representations of GPT-2 Small ( Radford et al., 2019 ) as the continuous latent space.
We additionally evaluate scaling to ELF-M in App. C.4 .
We compare ELF-MMD and ELF-MMD + + IRD with ELF, ELF-PD ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , ELF-GAN (see App. E.2 for training details), and FMLM + + ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ) , which is initialized from a pretrained masked diffusion model.
Applying a shifted timestep schedule ( Esser et al., 2024 ) improves the accuracy of both ELF and ELF-PD across all evaluated step budgets.
Thus, we use shift values of 32 and 128, respectively.

我们的主比较法是ELF-B 和最后一层隐藏
GPT-2 Small(拉德福德等,2019年)作为连续潜在空间的表示.
我们还评估了在App.C.4中向ELF-M的升级。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , ELF-MMD improves accuracy over ELF at every evaluated sampling budget and over ELF-PD at most of them. IRD further improves accuracy at every evaluated budget. At 4 and 8 steps, accuracy rises from 14.2 % 14.2\% to 20.8 % 20.8\% and from 27.5 % 27.5\% to 32.5 % 32.5\% , respectively, compared with 15.9 % 15.9\% and 23.5 % 23.5\% for ELF-PD. At 64 steps, ELF-MMD + + IRD reaches its highest accuracy of 36.3 % 36.3\% , compared with 35.2 % 35.2\% for ELF-MMD and 31.6 % 31.6\% for ELF. Exact results are reported in Tab. 4 .

We also apply the MMD loss to ELF ⋆ ( Yoo et al., 2026 ) and FMLM + + ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ) , yielding ELF ⋆ -MMD and FMLM + + -MMD.
Their post-training details and results are provided in App. F .

For MDLM-based models, we also evaluate pass@ k k using ancestral sampling at temperature 0.
Fig. 11 shows that MDLM-MMD outperforms the baselines at 4–8 sampling steps for k ≤ 8 k\leq 8 .
At 16–32 steps, it also achieves higher pass@ k k for most evaluated values of k k , with smaller differences at larger sample budgets.
For continuous DLMs, ELF-MMD also improves pass@ k k at smaller sample budgets, while the gaps narrow as k k increases.

blocks.en: 4.3 Scaling to Large Models
blocks.zh: 4.3 扩大为大型模型

blocks.en:
To test whether MMD post-training extends to larger models, we start from the released 16B DMax-Math and DMax-Coder checkpoints ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
DMax is a hybrid masked–uniform diffusion model tuned from LLaDa2.0-Mini ( Bie et al., 2025 ) that learns to recover target tokens from both masked inputs and its own token predictions.
We follow the original training implementation and use MMD to train on both masked inputs and the model’s own token predictions, yielding DMax-Math-MMD and DMax-Coder-MMD.
blocks.zh:
为了测试MMD训练后是否推广到更大的模式,我们从释放的16B DMax-Math和DMax-Coder检查站开始(Chen等,2026b.).
DMax是一种由LLaDa2.0-Mini(Bie等人,2025年)调制的混合掩体-单体扩散模型,它学习从被掩体输入物和它自己的活体预测中回收目标活物.
我们跟踪最初的训练实施过程, 并使用MMD来训练蒙面输入和模型本身的符号预测,

blocks.en:
We perform 400 training steps that take ∼ 13 {\sim}13 minutes for DMax-Math and ∼ 19 {\sim}19 minutes for DMax-Coder on eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs, corresponding to ∼ 1.7 {\sim}1.7 and ∼ 2.5 {\sim}2.5 GPU-hours per run, respectively.
These timings cover training only, excluding initialization and evaluation.

我们执行400个训练步骤,在8个NVIDIA H100 GPU上为DMax-Math用13分钟,在DMax-Coder用19分钟,分别为1.7 {\ sim}1.7和2.5 {\ sim}2.5 GPU小时。
这些时间只包括培训,不包括初始化和评价。

blocks.en:
We use the released DMax training data, which contain LLaDA-2.0-mini-generated responses to math and code prompts.
For math, we follow the original chain-of-thought evaluation on GSM8K, MATH500 ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) , Minerva-Algebra ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , and ASDIV ( Miao et al., 2020 ) .
For code, we report pass@1 on HumanEval-Instruct ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and MBPP-Instruct ( Austin et al., 2021b ) .
Evaluation uses the original dInfer ( Ma et al., 2025 ) implementation with Soft Parallel Decoding, a block size of 32 32 , and a maximum generation length of 2048 2048 tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们使用发布的DMax训练数据,其中包含LLaDA-2.0-mini生成的对数学和代码提示的响应.
在数学方面,我们遵循了最初对GSM8K,MATH500(Lightman等,2024年),Minerva-Algebra的思维链评价. (Hendrycks等,2021年),和ASDIV(Miao等,2020年).
关于代码,我们报告通过@1的HumanEval-Instruct(Chen等,2021年)和MBPP-Instruct(Austin等,2021年b).

Tab. 1 compares these metrics with the original paper’s baselines.
We select threshold 0.85 0.85 for DMax-Math-MMD and 0.9 0.9 for DMax-Coder-MMD.
Across the four math benchmarks, DMax-Math-MMD increases TPF by 10.3 10.3 – 16.5 % 16.5\% over the reported DMax-Math operating points while achieving similar or higher accuracy.
On code benchmarks, DMax-Coder-MMD improves accuracy by 2.4 2.4 percentage points on HumanEval-Instruct and 3.8 3.8 points on MBPP-Instruct, while also increasing TPF on both benchmarks.
To show how this trade-off varies with decoding threshold, we provide accuracy–TPF curves in App. D , together with the selected thresholds and aggregation details.

blocks.en: 4.4 MMD Loss Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.4 小额供资和微型企业司 损失

blocks.en:
Finally, we compare alternative loss formulations on GSM8K (Fig. 4 ), with OWT results in App. C.1 .
We start with linear-kernel MMD, computed as MSE between generated and reference feature means.
This baseline tests whether matching first moments is sufficient and connects to feature matching for LLMs ( Jelassi et al., 2026 ) .
Beyond mean matching, we compare sequence-level RBF on mean-pooled embeddings with our token-level RBF.
This aims to address whether retaining token-level interactions improves the MMD training signal.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们比较了GSM8K(图4)的替代损失配方,而OTW的结果载于App.C.1。
我们从线内核MMD开始, 计算为 MSE 在生成和引用特性之间。
这一基线测试是否足以匹配最初时刻,并连接到LLMS的特性匹配(Jelassi等人,2026年)。
除了表示匹配,我们比较序列级 RBF 在平均集合嵌入与我们的符号级 RBF。
此举旨在解决保留象征层面互动是否能改善MMD培训信号的问题.

blocks.en:
The attraction-only variant removes the generated–generated repulsive term to test whether similarity to reference features alone suffices.
Finally, a feature regression baseline minimizes MSE between the full intermediate feature tensors of sampled and reference sequences at corresponding positions.
blocks.zh:
仅取景的变体会去掉生成的-生成的反感名词,以测试仅与参考特征的相似性是否足够.
最后,一个特征回归基线将取样的全部中间特征分数和相应位置的参考序列之间的MSE最小化.

blocks.en:
On GSM8K, token-level RBF gives the strongest accuracy–computation trade-off, with larger gains for discrete models and more modest improvements for continuous models.
Attraction-only and feature regression losses yield lower accuracy, particularly for continuous models.
The OWT results in Fig. 5 similarly favor token-level RBF for both discrete and continuous models in most setups. These results support our choice of token-level RBF.

仅吸引和特征回归损失的准确性较低,特别是对于连续模型而言。
OWT结果为图. 5同样有利于大多数设置的离散和连续模型的符号级RBF. 这些结果支持我们选择象征级的RBF.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Our results show that MMD on pretrained DLM features can improve generation in both discrete and continuous DLMs.
These improvements are obtained with a simple and efficient training procedure that requires neither full sampling trajectories nor jointly trained auxiliary models.
Nevertheless, performance depends on choices such as the RBF bandwidth and the representation space used for distribution matching.
This makes representation design a natural direction for further exploration.
We use features from a single layer on clean inputs, but combining features across layers or noise levels, or using an ensemble of extractors, could provide complementary information.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果表明,在预先训练的DLM特性上的MMD可以改善离散和连续的DLM的生成.
这些改进是通过简单而有效的培训程序取得的,这种程序既不需要完整的取样轨迹,也不需要联合培训的辅助模型。
尽管如此,性能取决于RBF带宽和用于配给的表示空间等选择.
这使得代表设计成为进一步探索的自然方向.
我们使用单层的特性来进行清洁的输入,但结合各层的特性或噪声水平,或使用一组提取器,可以提供补充信息。

blocks.en:
Alongside representation design, future work could explore combining MMD with other training objectives for discrete DLMs.
Such combinations may offer further benefits in practice, as suggested by the gains from applying IRD after ELF-MMD post-training in the continuous setting.
blocks.zh:
除了代表设计外,今后的工作还可以探讨将多边多边发展中心与其他单独的DLM培训目标结合起来。
这种组合在实践中可能带来进一步的好处,在ELF-MMD的连续培训之后应用IRD的好处就表明了这一点。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en:
Diffusion language modeling can be formulated over discrete tokens or continuous representations of text.
Masked models such as MDLM ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ) and MD4 ( Shi et al., 2024 ) learn to recover missing tokens, a formulation that also underlies many large discrete DLMs ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Bie et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) .
Uniform DLMs instead replace tokens with uniformly sampled vocabulary items during corruption ( Hoogeboom et al., 2021 ; Schiff et al., 2025 ; Sahoo et al., 2025 ) .
Their reverse process can revise token identities throughout denoising, as in DiffusionGemma ( Team et al., 2026 ) .
Continuous models denoise token embeddings ( Li et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2026 ) , encoder latents ( Lovelace et al., 2023 ; Meshchaninov et al., 2025 ; Meshchaninov et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) , or noisy one-hot representations ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Agarwal et al., 2026 ) .
Our continuous realization builds on ELF ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , which learns a flow in a frozen contextual embedding space.
blocks.zh:
传播语言的建模可以通过离散符号或连续表示文本来制定.
MDLM(Sahoo等人,2024年)和MD4(Shi等人,2024年)等被蒙住的模型学会了找回缺失的活物,这种配方也是许多大型离散DLM的基础(Nie等人,2025年;Bie等人,2025年;Fu等人,2026年)。
统一DLMs取代了腐败期间统一抽样的词汇项目(Hoogeboom等,2021;Schiff等,2025;Sahoo等,2025)。
它们的倒置过程可以在整个发号施令过程中修改象征身份,如DifmusionGemma(Team等,2026年).
连续模式 denoise 符号嵌入 (Li等,2022;Chen等,2026a;Deschenaux和Gulcehre,2026),编码器潜伏物 (Lovelace等人,2023年;Meshchaninov等人,2025年;Meshchaninov等人,2026年;Hu等人,2026年),或吵闹的一热表示. (Lee等,2026;Agarwal等,2026).
我们的不断实现建立在ELF(Hu等, 2026年)的基础上,

blocks.en:
One way to reduce sampling cost is to train a model to reproduce several denoising steps at once.
Direct and progressive distillation ( Luhman and Luhman, 2021 ; Salimans and Ho, 2022 ) learn from teacher-generated targets, while consistency models ( Song et al., 2023 ) and flow-map matching ( Boffi et al., 2025 ) provide related ways to learn large transitions through the generative process.
For language, ELF applies progressive distillation, and FMLM ( Lee et al., 2026 ) learns the flow map of a continuous language model.
FMLM+ ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ) extends FMLM with masking-style noise schedules and posterior-guided refinement.
FMLM ⋆ ( Yoo et al., 2026 ) combines fixed-point and flow-map distillation for self-conditioned models.
DLM-One ( Chen et al., 2025 ) takes a distribution-matching approach based on score distillation and adversarial regularization.
Our MMD stage trains a latent generator through comparisons with reference samples in a fixed feature space.
We use self-conditioning to refine its predictions at a fixed diffusion time and optionally distill these refinement steps afterward.
blocks.zh:
降低采样成本的一种方法是培训一个模型,以同时复制几个去名步骤.
直接和渐进地分馏(Luhman and Luhman, 2021;Salimans and Ho, 2022)从教师产生的目标中学习,而一致性模型(Song等, 2023)和流量-映射相配(Boffi等, 2025)则提供了通过基因过程学习大过渡的相关方法.
对于语言,ELF应用了渐进分馏,而FMLM(Lee等,2026年)学习了连续语言模型的流图.
FMLM+(Agarwal等,2026年)将FMLM扩展为口罩式噪音表和后导精度.
FMLM QQ (Yoo等, 2026) 结合了固定点和流图分馏,用于自备型号.
DLM-One(Chen等,2025年)基于分数分馏和对抗性规范化,采取配分比法.
我们的MMD阶段通过与固定特性空间中的参考样本进行比较来训练潜在的生成器。
我们使用自修来在固定的传播时间完善它的预测,并可以选择地提炼出这些后期的完善步骤.

blocks.en:
SDTT ( Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2025 ) accelerates discrete DLMs by training a student to match token distributions collected across several teacher denoising steps.
Inspired by consistency models ( Song et al., 2023 ) , CDLM ( Kim et al., 2025b ) combines teacher-logit distillation with consistency regularization across discrete denoising states.
Other approaches construct distribution-matching objectives using learned auxiliary models.
IDLM ( Li et al., 2026 ) and Discrete Moment Matching Distillation (D-MMD) ( Hoogeboom et al., 2026 ) train an auxiliary denoiser and update the generator by differentiating through soft token predictions.
DiDi-Instruct ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) instead uses policy gradients with a learned density-ratio discriminator.
Our discrete formulation also uses policy gradients, with rewards computed directly from MMD in frozen features.
blocks.zh:
SDTT(Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2025)通过培训一名学生以匹配在几个教师代言步骤中收集的符号分配,加速了离散的DLM.
受一致性模式的启发 (Song等,2023年),CDLM(Kim等,2025年b)结合了教师-记录分解与各离散去诺状态的一致性规范.
其他方法利用学到的辅助模型构建分配匹配目标。
IDLM (Li等, 2026年)和Discrete Moment Matching Distillation (D-MMD)(Hoogeboom等, 2026年)通过软符号预测进行分化来训练辅助denoiser并更新生成器.
Di- 指示 (郑等,2026年)取而代之的是使用具有所学密度-比例歧视论者的政策梯度.
我们的离散表述还采用政策梯度,奖励直接取自冷冻特性的MMD。

blocks.en:
MMD has long been used to train implicit generators from samples ( Li et al., 2015 ) .
Its effectiveness depends on the representation in which samples are compared.
MMD-GAN ( Li et al., 2017 ) learns this representation adversarially, whereas GFMN ( dos Santos et al., 2019 ) matches feature statistics from frozen pretrained networks.
For diffusion models, MMD-DDM ( Aiello et al., 2024 ) fine-tunes samplers for a fixed step budget.
SwD ( Starodubcev et al., 2026 ) brings these ideas together through patch-level MMD on pretrained diffusion features, directly motivating our use of contextual token features.
Inductive Moment Matching ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) uses MMD to enforce distributional consistency across sampling intervals.
Related objectives include Representation Fréchet Loss ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , which compares feature means and covariances, and Drifting Models ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Oba et al., 2026 ) , which regress to targets defined by an attraction–repulsion field.
blocks.zh:
MMD长期以来被用于从样本中培训隐性发电机(Li等,2015.).
其有效性取决于样本的比较情况。
MMD-GAN(Li等,2017年)以对抗性的方式学习了这种代表,而GFMN(dos Santos等,2019年)则与被冻结的预训网络的特征统计相匹配.
对于传播模型,MMD-DDM(Aiello等,2024年)对定步预算进行微调取样器.
SWD(Starodubcev等,2026年)通过关于被预先训练的传播特性的补丁级MMD将这些想法汇集在一起,直接激励我们使用上下文符号特性.
诱导运动相配(周克等,2025年)使用MMD在采样间隔间执行分布一致性.
相关的目标包括代表Fréchet Loss(Yang等,2026年),比较特征手段和共性,和漂流模型(Deng等,2026年;Oba等,2026年),它们倒退到由取景地所定义的目标上.

blocks.en:
Frozen-feature matching has also been explored directly for text generation.
SeqGFMN ( Padhi et al., 2020 ) matches position-wise means and variances of token features and differentiates through soft token outputs.
More recently, Energy-Based Fine-Tuning (EBFT) ( Jelassi et al., 2026 ) fine-tunes autoregressive models using frozen features of short rollouts and policy-gradient updates.
Its basic, unwhitened objective corresponds to conditional linear-kernel MMD, with whitening and reward modifications in the practical training recipe.
EBFT represents each rollout by a single feature vector.
We instead compare distributions of token features using an RBF kernel, applying the objective to parallel discrete predictions or continuous latent samples.
blocks.zh:
也为文本生成直接探索了冻地相配.
页:1 (Padhi等,2020年) 匹配了位置方法以及象征特征的差异,并通过软象征输出来区分.
最近,基于能源的精细调整(EBFT)(Jelassi等,2026年)利用短片推出和政策升级更新的冷冻特性,对自旋模型进行了微调。
它的基本,未白化的目标与有条件的线性内核MMD相对应,在实用训练配方中进行白化和奖励修改.
EBFT以单一特性向量代表每次推出.
相反,我们用一个RBF内核来比较象征特征的分布,将目标应用于平行的离散预测或连续的潜在样本。

blocks.en: C.2.1 Input Representations
blocks.zh: C.2.1 投入说明

blocks.en: We compute MMD directly on token embeddings from the frozen MDLM’s vocabulary embedding matrix. Unlike intermediate hidden states, these embeddings depend only on token identity and do not capture the surrounding context.
blocks.zh: 我们直接在被冻结的MDLM词汇嵌入矩阵上的符号嵌入上计算MMD. 与中间隐藏状态不同,这些嵌入状态只依赖于象征身份,不捕捉周围上下文.

blocks.en: We compute MMD directly in the latent space of the pretrained text encoder, using the identity feature map ϕ ⁡ ( x ) = x \phi(x)=x . These latents already encode contextual information, allowing distribution matching without an additional feature extractor.
blocks.zh: 我们使用身份特征图 QQ (x) = x\phi (x) = x 来直接在预训文本编码器的潜在空间中计算 MMD 。 这些潜入物已经编码了上下文信息,允许在不附加特性提取器的情况下进行发行匹配.

blocks.en: C.2.2 External Encoder
blocks.zh: C.2.2 外部编码器

blocks.en: We use a frozen autoregressive language model pretrained on the same dataset. We extract contextual token features from an intermediate layer for both generated and reference sequences and compute MMD over these features.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个冷冻自递性语言模型 预先训练在同一数据集。 我们从中间层取出背景标志性特征,用于生成和参考序列,并在这些特征上计算MMD.

blocks.en: Inspired by the latent-space MAE encoder in Drifting Models ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , we train a separate Transformer on real ELF latents using masked-token cross-entropy rather than latent reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 受漂流模型(Deng等,2026年)中潜入空间的MAE编码器的启发,我们用蒙面相交而不是潜入重建,在真正的ELF潜入上单独训练了一台变形器.

blocks.en: Diffusion-based features achieve the highest accuracy for both discrete and continuous DLMs. They outperform token embeddings and autoregressive features in the discrete setting, as well as input latents and external-encoder features in the continuous setting.
blocks.zh: 基于分泌的特性对离散和连续的DLM都实现了最高的精度. 它们超越了符号嵌入和自相递入离散设置中的特性,以及连续设置中的输入潜入和外接编码器特性.

blocks.en: C.5 Bootstrapping

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 3.3 , bootstrapping helps reduce the mismatch between training and inference. We vary the number of bootstrap steps during generator training, including a baseline without bootstrapping. As shown in Fig. 10 , a single bootstrap step already provides performance gains, while additional steps yield limited or inconsistent improvements. Since each additional step increases training costs, a small number of bootstrap steps offers a practical balance between generation quality and computational overhead.

For TinyGSM, we adapt this code to conditional generation and additionally use classifier-free guidance (CFG) during training. We find that the resulting model still requires self-conditioning, so we use ELF-style sampling with self-conditioning for the TinyGSM checkpoint only.

blocks.en: We initialize ELF-GAN from pretrained ELF-B checkpoints and adversarially post-train it on OWT and TinyGSM. A four-layer MLP discriminator operates on token features extracted by a frozen ELF. We use logistic discriminator and non-saturating generator losses, averaged over non-prompt positions, with five discriminator updates per generator update. We retain decoder fine-tuning (App. B.2 ) and use the same generator optimizer and learning rate as ELF-MMD. A sequence-level variant that mean-pools features over non-prompt positions performs similarly to the token-level objective.
